kills.property: After Alice deposits 1 ether, MinSum is set to 1, then Alice calls Collect(1): in the reference contract the balance becomes 0 and the call succeeds (sends 1 ether), while in the buggy contract the balance becomes -1 (underflow revert) because Deposit subtracted 1 from 0, so Collect fails.
kills.change_summary: Replace the addition in balances update with subtraction, so Deposit decreases the balance instead of increasing it.

kills.property: After calling Collect with an amount exactly equal to balances[caller] (which triggers a call to receive() sending 0 value, which in reference calls Deposit and passes require(balances[msg.sender] + msg.value >= balances[msg.sender]) but in buggy version reverts on require(false)), the reference successfully completes the Collect and updates Log, while buggy version reverts.
kills.change_summary: Replace the require statement with require(false) to always revert.
